messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing segment. Two things my team needs clarified: 1) exact UTC/time-of-day when dev credits reset, and 2) what the expected developer flow will be for short-lived CI/test exemptions (programmatic vs manual).

Leah (CEO): Short answers: credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the 1st. Exemptions are manual today but we're shipping a self-serve path for org admins H2. More detail below.

Sana (Finance): Adding: dev sandbox credits are a fixed monthly allotment and currently do not roll over. Enterprise customers can negotiate rollover/buffer credits in their SOWs. For large exemptions (>1M tokens/month) we still require finance sign-off.

Riley (Platform): Technical sketch: we plan short-lived exemption tokens plus an org-admin toggle in Console. Two access modes: header-based ephemeral tokens for CI (e.g., X-Redwood-Test-Exempt) and account-level allowances for planned load tests. Everything will be logged for billing/audit.

Jamal (SRE): Clarifying Q: is the cluster burst pool shared or isolated per-customer? If header tokens bypass normal limits, we need to ensure SLOs and KV caching accounting still apply.

Riley (Platform): Burst strategy: cluster-global pool with per-customer soft caps to avoid noisy neighbors. Exemptions won't bypass SLOs; they only change billing/quota gating. We'll ensure the metrics pipeline tags exempted requests. Example policy snippet: 

```
exemption:
  mode: ephemeral_header
  header_name: X-Redwood-Test-Exempt
  max_duration_min: 240
  audit: true
```

Sana (Finance): Operational note: auto-approval thresholds will be conservative at first (proposal: <=100k tokens/day auto, 100k-1M manager approval, >1M finance review). We'll publish exact thresholds in the docs when product locks them down.

Nina: Helpful. For the rollover pilot Leah mentioned  any idea who qualifies and when it starts?

Leah (CEO): Rollover pilot is a limited opt-in for dev-heavy orgs planned for Q3. Product will reach out to a shortlist. Internally we'll expose an opt-in flag and a CSV export of monthly credit usage for reconciliation.

Jamal (SRE): Action item: if we support header-based exemptions, I'll validate that quota accounting and token billing still emit correct usage events. I'll open a ticket and tag Riley/Sana.

OpsBot: Draft pricing-exemptions doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing-exemptions (internal).

Riley (Platform): UX action: add an "Exemptions" tab in Console for H2 with history, remaining allowance, and revoke buttons.

Sana (Finance): Finance will publish the proposed thresholds and a short FAQ after product finalizes the RFC.

Nina: Thanks all. I'll file the GH issue to track the header token shape, metrics tagging, and the Console flag. @Riley @Jamal @Sana please add acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

Leah (CEO): Thanks. We'll update the product board and follow up in the next all-hands.
